about.heading: Engineering systems that connect businesses, technology, and people.
about.p1: My career spans more than 15 years across digital banking, fintech, telecommunications, and enterprise software. I have worked as a software engineer, backend team lead, and software architect, designing systems that integrate complex platforms and support critical business operations.
about.p2: My work combines hands-on backend development with architecture, technical leadership, and cross-team collaboration. I focus on reliable APIs, resilient integration patterns, maintainability, and practical engineering decisions.

About.title: About Abdalla

story.p1: I'm a Senior Software Engineer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with more than 15 years of experience in backend development, software architecture, and enterprise integration.
story.p2: My professional journey began in software and embedded systems engineering and expanded into enterprise platforms, telecommunications, fintech, and digital banking.
story.p3: Today, I focus primarily on Java and Spring Boot, microservices, payment integrations, and event-driven architectures. I enjoy working across the full engineering lifecycle, from understanding business requirements and defining API contracts to designing, implementing, testing, and deploying reliable backend services.
story.p4: I have also led engineering teams, reviewed architectures, mentored developers, and worked with product owners, platform engineers, security teams, and external technology providers.
story.p5: My engineering philosophy is to solve the right problem with the appropriate level of complexity: prioritize clarity, reliability, maintainability, and effective collaboration over unnecessary abstraction.

right.title: Solve the right problem
right.body: Start from the business requirement and the API contract before choosing a design.

complexity.title: Appropriate complexity
complexity.body: Prefer clarity and maintainability over unnecessary abstraction.

reliability.title: Reliability through collaboration
reliability.body: Reliable services come from clear contracts, careful testing, and close work with every team involved.
